name: Marco Ho
headline:
I'm Marco.
I build AI tools.
intro: Based in Hong Kong. My work so far: autonomous research agents, a video creation studio, and language models for English and Cantonese.
about: I studied Computer Engineering at HKUST, with an extended major in AI. For my final-year project, I worked on English and Cantonese embeddings for a conversational wellness assessment system. Since then, I've been building research agents and content automation at New Media Lab, alongside my own projects.
education: HKUST · BEng Computer Engineering · Extended Major in AI · First Class Honours, 2025

projects.name: Charamelt
projects.description: A studio for turning a topic or script into an editable video. Characters, voice, captions, and scene layouts can be changed separately before rendering.
projects.note: An engineering detail: edits preserve compatible narration and scene geometry, while invalidating reviews that no longer match. Background jobs keep running when the browser closes.

projects.name: LLM-based email rewriter
projects.description: A small Flask and React app that rewrites a draft email using its purpose and your instructions. The prompt asks the model to preserve facts, dates, and requests.
projects.note: Flask serves both the API and the built React frontend. The model and OpenAI-compatible provider can be configured.

projects.name: The Tower — farming tier calculator
projects.description: A calculator for The Tower that estimates a theoretical farming tier from the highest tier and wave reached.
projects.note: A focused game tool: a small input, a concrete calculation, and a result to compare against your runs.

experience.description: Built autonomous research and content workflows, text optimization tools, and automated data pipelines.
Worked on a production AI chatbot, a JavaScript-to-TypeScript backend migration, and SQL data workflows.

contact_heading: Talk code, AI, or a project.
interests: I like projects with a specific problem to work on: editing a generated video, rewriting an awkward email, or figuring out which tier to farm in a game. My research work took me into English and Cantonese NLP. Those are the two sides of my work so far: language models and small tools with a clear job.
now: Working on Charamelt: story and scene editing, background generation, and keeping reviews consistent when a video changes.
